correctness.rationale: The proof establishes smoothness of both genus-two quotients on the exact parameter open set, genus five by shared-branch Riemann–Hurwitz and a 2-power separable three-quotient isogeny. Direct expansion of \(F_w^5\) verifies the genus-two Cartier matrix with determinant \(3(w^2-3)^2(w^2-4)^3\). Each block is zero at \(w=5,6\) and invertible otherwise on this open set; the elliptic Hasse coefficient controls its one-dimensional stable rank. The two quartic special-line restrictions have four simple admissible roots each and avoid intersections of special lines, proving all sixteen distinct transverse rank-two points and both rank-one points. Symbolic and independent \(\mathbb F_{121}\) direct coefficient checkers execute successfully. The full result rests on exact algebra and the isogeny, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The finite intersection scheme has intrinsic motivation: simultaneous degeneracy of a genus-two factor and the remaining elliptic quotient in a five-dimensional Jacobian. Its exact reduced length sixteen, transverse structure and degree-one/degree-two arithmetic orbit decomposition describe nontrivial positive-characteristic rank-drop geometry. The rank-one minimum is isolated at two ordered parameters, and the full formula excludes rank zero while realizing ranks one through five. The contribution is a natural complete arithmetic stratification in the established family, not a mere renamed general isogeny.
